extracted.name: Watermelon Salad
extracted.description: This watermelon salad made with sweet and juicy watermelon, pickled red onion, cucumber, and salty feta is a delicious and refreshing crowd-pleasing salad.
ingredient_lines: 1 cup sliced red onion, cut lengthwise
instruction_lines: Place red onion slices in a small bowl; pour over lime juice. Allow onions to marinate while assembling the salad.
Gently combine watermelon, cucumber, feta cheese, and cilantro in a large bowl; season with black pepper.
Toss watermelon salad with marinated onions and season with sea salt just before serving.
